name: npmrc-read-for-registry-url
note: Was the ONLY heuristic false block in the top-1000 (registry-url@7.2.0, 100M+ downloads/wk, 2026-07-19 batch scan). Reads .npmrc solely to parse the `registry` URL; no _authToken and no network egress. Retuned 2026-07-19: credential-access on .npmrc is INFO when the file references no auth field and has no network sink (see credentialSeverity). The malicious .npmrc-token-theft shape (advisory-eslint-scope-npmrc) reads the file AND POSTs it, so it trips the network sink and stays HIGH.
